_note: FIT click-to-WhatsApp ads (Ads agent v1). Read by scripts/ads_ops.py. Caps here are hard limits enforced in code. Only Rishi changes caps, budget_approved or launch_approved.
prefill_message: Hi, I saw the FIT ad. Please share details of Forteasia Industrial Township, Rohtak.

adsets.name: FIT A - Industry owners, Haryana and NCR

ads.name: A1 permanent address
ads.headline: Industrial plots in Rohtak
ads.text: A permanent address for your factory. Forteasia Industrial Township on Meham-Beri Road, Rohtak: plots of 500 to 4,000 sq yd on 18 m and 24 m roads built for trucks. RERA registered. Message us on WhatsApp for the plan, plot sizes and current rates.

ads.name: A2 built for industry
ads.headline: 138+ acre industrial township
ads.text: A 138+ acre township planned for industry: wide roads, power, water, drainage and sewage treatment, with homes and shops for your staff. 25 min to IMT Rohtak, 10 min to NH-152D. Chat on WhatsApp to get the brochure.

ads.name: A3 right plot
ads.headline: Factory and warehouse plots
ads.text: Planning a new unit or warehouse? FIT, Rohtak has industrial plots from 500 to 4,000 sq yd for manufacturing, warehousing, logistics and MSMEs. HRERA-PKL-ROH-795-2025. Ask anything on WhatsApp, in Hindi or English.

adsets.name: FIT B - Plot investors 28 to 55, Rohtak and NCR

ads.name: B1 right plot
ads.headline: RERA-registered plots, Rohtak
ads.text: Industrial, residential and SCO plots in one 138+ acre township at Kalanaur, Rohtak. RERA registered (HRERA-PKL-ROH-795-2025, 653-2025) with DTCP licences. Check the approvals and plot sizes on WhatsApp.

ads.name: B2 built for industry
ads.headline: A township near IMT Rohtak
ads.text: Forteasia Industrial Township sits 25 min from IMT Rohtak and 10 min from NH-152D, near IMT Jhajjar and Reliance MET City. Residential plots from 90 sq yd, industrial from 500 sq yd. Get the master plan on WhatsApp.

ads.name: B3 permanent address
ads.headline: Plots by Forteasia, Rohtak
ads.text: Forteasia has delivered 5.33 million sq ft across Haryana. Its newest township, FIT on Meham-Beri Road, Rohtak, has RERA-registered industrial, residential and SCO plots. Message us for the brochure and a site visit.

adsets.name: FIT C - Retargeting chatters and engagers
adsets._note: Week 2. Enable with op enable_retargeting after op audiences has built the audiences. Budget comes out of A and B so the daily total never rises.
